- `basic.xlsx`: generated by `cargo test -- --ignored write_fixture`.
- `date*.{xls,xlsb,ods}`, `pass_protected.*`: copied from [calamine](https://github.com/tafia/calamine/tree/master/tests) (MIT).
- `bad_dimension.xlsx`: `basic.xlsx` with the `<dimension>` tag of the Data and People sheets rewritten to `A1` (as some writers do), to test streamed row widths. Rewrite the tag in `xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml` and `sheet3.xml` with `zipfile`.
